title: A flat-Cauchy subsequence from finite nets, with real error currents and supports in a fixed compact set (Simon 7.2, (5))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, let L ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and let X_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ). Suppose the following holds for every ε ∈ (0, ∞]: there is a finite set 𝒬 ⊆ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that for every j there are Q ∈ 𝒬, an integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) with spt R ⊆ L, and a current S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), with X_j − Q − S = ∂R and M(R) + M(S) ≤ ε. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every r ∈ ℕ there are an integer multiplicity R_r ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) with spt R_r ⊆ L and a current S_r ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with X_{φ(r+1)} − X_{φ(r)} − S_r = ∂R_r and M(R_r) + M(S_r) ≤ 2^{−r}, written (2⁻¹)^r in [0, ∞]. M = mass = M_{ℝ^P}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (L : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact L → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ j, ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ R.support ⊆ L ∧ X j - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ ε) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ R.support ⊆ L ∧ X (φ (r + 1)) - X (φ r) - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
